title: Uruguayan Wild Garlic Empanadas
description: A crowd-pleasing Uruguayan dish featuring wild garlic leaves and a jammy filling, these empanadas are perfect for a snack or lunch. The katsuramuki-cut wild garlic leaves add a nice texture to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the katsuramuki-cut wild garlic leaves to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Spoon a small amount of jam onto the center of each dough circle.
Add a spoonful of the wild garlic mixture on top of the jam.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
